version: E2B Embed (e2b-dev/runtime main; orchestrator v0.16.202610201713, Firecracker v1.14-0.2.0, SDK 2.46.1)

install.detail: 2 files + docker compose up; ~10 containers + host orchestrator/firecracker; Apache-2.0, no account. Heavy host mutation (modules, sysctl, hugepages, udev, ~300 iptables rules); 13 unauthenticated ports on all interfaces incl. 5008.

headless.detail: Fully scriptable via node SDK/HTTP; runs as root-in-VM or user; no TTY. Host needs docker group/sudo for stack only.

adapter.detail: orchestrator/adapters/e2b.py via node CLI in container; create/exec/destroy and binary tar over stdin verified; ~1.5 s per call overhead (docker run). gateway_env not wired.

egress.detail: Default is allow-all internet; denyOut 0.0.0.0/0 + allowOut domains (SNI/Host) works; RFC1918/link-local/loopback always denied; blocked TCP connect() appears to succeed (app-level check needed).

credentials.detail: network.rules header transform accepted but NOT applied (httpbin saw only client header); Secret.create 403 'Secrets are not available for this team'; SOCKS5 egressProxy requires non-internal IP, not testable here.

gateway.detail: LLM gw 172.18.0.4 / pkg gw 172.18.0.2 / LiteLLM <host> unreachable (private ranges hard-denied). Workaround via public-looking alias IP (198.18.0.10) works but source IP is identical for all sandboxes, so IP->key mapping fails; identity would need per-task destination addr/port.

compose.detail: Custom template e2b-docker (build 44 s): fixture 15/15 healthy in 13 s (27 s incl. dockerd/pull), nslookup web.cz.test 172.30.0.2 OK, no --privileged (root in Firecracker VM). Root disk only 813 MB.

isolation.detail: Separate disks, no cross-sandbox network (169.254.0.22/10.11.0.1 timeout), host/LAN unreachable. Same boot_id and eth0 IP 169.254.0.21 across sandboxes.

lifecycle.detail: Destroy frees hugepages/nbd/firecracker; pause 0.14 s, resume 0.30 s keeping files and processes; 3 parallel create+exec 0.66 s. Snapshot/fork exist in API, untested. Memory pool (2 GiB hugepages) limits concurrency.

verdict: E2B Embed really runs Firecracker microVMs with very fast start (0.17 s), pause/resume and Docker Compose inside (15/15 healthy), but it is a heavy host-mutating stack (~5 GiB RAM + hugepages, unauthenticated ports on LAN) and cannot serve as a credential gateway here: header transforms and secrets do not work in Embed, private ranges are hard-blocked so factory gateways are unreachable, and source IP gives no per-sandbox identity. Usable as a pure sandbox runtime only if gateway access is rebuilt around a non-private per-task address; ram_idle_mb is per sandbox, stack baseline ~5 GiB.
